items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: we borrowed a, a friend of ours in the Village named Casey

ctx.x: And do your business here. But I don't know where to go because we can't live on Long Island or hardly anywhere on account of the racial problem. We borrowed a, I don't know whether I told you this or not, we borrowed a, a friend of ours in the Village named Casey, who owns Casey's Restaurant, actually he's Chinese and his grandfather is a (Tungsten?) billionnaire. He lent us his chauffeur and limousine and we went out to Long Island to look for a house. And even with the chauffeur and limousine as soon as they…
I thought money covered everything but even with the chauffeur and limousine it doesn't.
